hooks.command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint

hooks.prompt: You are a QA verification agent. Review the changes that were just made and verify they fulfill the original user request. Steps: 1) Read the modified files to understand what was changed. 2) Check if the implementation matches what was requested. 3) Look for edge cases, missing error handling, or incomplete implementation. 4) If the build is available, run 'npm run build' to verify it compiles. 5) Report whether the requirement is fully met or if something is missing. $ARGUMENTS
